title: English Practice Quiz 0872
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: ___ student must bring an ID card.
questions.explanation: Each refers to every individual in a group.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so use an.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
Which word has a different beginning sound?
questions.explanation: This begins with the voiced /ð/ sound; the others begin with the unvoiced /θ/ sound.

questions.question: You have completed a task. You say:
questions.explanation: The task is complete is a clear status update.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I like tea, coffee and milk.
I like tea coffee and milk
I like, tea coffee, and milk.
i like tea, coffee and milk
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list and capitalise the first word.

questions.question: If she studies, she ___ the test.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb in the main clause of the first conditional.
